capabilities: Read local reflowable EPUB books with table of contents, typography and saved position
Highlight passages and write thoughts while reading
Store annotations in a .leafmark.json file beside each book
Create Canvas excerpt cards that link to exact book passages
Import earlier Markdown excerpts with warnings for unsupported data
extras: Not yet listed in the official Obsidian directory; initial desktop release tested only on macOS (mobile and Windows untested). All features are free, with voluntary WeChat Pay / Alipay donations accepted in the plugin settings. Scripted EPUB content is blocked for security, and users are warned not to enable multiple EPUB reader plugins simultaneously.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read EPUB books, and annotations made outside the vault don't link back to exact passages in the source text.

relations.evidence: The build removes EPUB.js script-loading methods (Contents.addScript and Rendition.injectScript)

summary: EPUB reader for Obsidian that lets you highlight passages and write thoughts, then collect source-linked excerpt cards on Canvas.
